description: This file defines a package-private class 'DistributedPubImpl' which implements the 'DistributedPub' interface, providing methods for retrieving an ActorRef publisher and wrapping messages for publication using a topic extractor and publisher class. It is part of a pub/sub utility within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DistributedPubImpl
classes.description: Implementation of 'DistributedPub' that provides access to a publisher actor and wraps messages for publication with topics extracted from the message.

methods.name: DistributedPubImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pub supervisor actor reference and topic extractor.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef representing the publisher.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps a message for publication by extracting topics and encapsulating in a Publisher message.
